content: Imsar umi ikemmeř Irmiya řhard nnes i marra řgens s marra awařen n SIDI, AREBBI nsen, s min zi tuɣa SIDI, AREBBI nsen, issekk i-t-i-dd ɣarsen,

aqa issiweř Ɛazarya, mmis n Hucaɛya, u nnan ɛawed Yuḥanan, mmis n Qariyaḥ, d marra yeryazen imɛeffaren i Irmiya: “Cek tessxarriqed. SIDI, AREBBI nneɣ, war cek dd-isekk maḥend ad tinid: ‘War iɛeddeř ad traḥem ɣar Miṣra maḥend ad dinni teqqimem am yibarraniyyen!’
Maca Barux, mmis n Niri-Yah, i cek i dd-iḥarrcen xaneɣ, ḥima ad aneɣ tsellmed ɣar ifassen n Ikaldaniyyen, maḥend ad aneɣ nɣen u ad aneɣ nedhen di lmenfa ɣar Babil.”
Ammu war isři Yuḥanan, mmis n Qariyaḥ, d marra ikumandaren n řɛeskar uřa d marra řgens ɣar tmijja n SIDI, maḥend ad qqimen di temmurt n Yahuda.
Yuḥanan, mmis n Qariyaḥ, d marra ikumandaren n řɛeskar ksin marra min iqqimen n Yahuda, inni tuɣa dd-idewřen zi marra řegnus ɣar mani xasen uẓẓřen, ḥima ad qqimen di temmurt n Yahuda:

iryazen ijehden d temɣarin d iḥenjiren imeẓyanen d yessis n ujeǧid d marra řeɛmar nni tuɣa ijja Nebuzaradan, řqebṭan n iɛessasen n arrimet, ɣar Jadalya, mmis n Axiqam, mmis n Cafan, uřa d anabi Irmiya d Barux, mmis n Niri-Yah.
Nitni usin-dd ɣar temmurt n Miṣra, minzi nitni war sřin ca ɣar tmijja n SIDI uca usin-dd ař Taḥfanis.
Xenni yusa-dd wawař n SIDI ɣar Irmiya di Taḥfanḥis, inna:
“Ksi iẓra imeqqranen deg ufus nnec uca nuffar i-ten deg ubeǧaɛ n tisi n luṣa ɣar wadaf n taddart n firɛun di Taḥfanis. Egg i-t zzat i tiṭṭawin n yeryazen n Yahuda,

ini asen: ‘Ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat, AREBBI n Israil: Xzar, Necc ad awyeɣ Nabuxadraṣṣar, ajeǧid n Babil, amsexxar inu, uca ad ggeɣ řɛarc nnes x yeẓra-ya nni nuffareɣ dinni, uca netta ad iwwet aqiḍun nnes igellden tiwa nsen.
Netta ad dd-yas uca ad iwwet tammurt n Miṣra: wenni iǧan i řmewt, s řmewt, d wenni iǧan i tmeḥbast, i uḥebbes, d wenni iǧan i ssif, s ssif.

Netta ad ssareɣ ict n tmessi deg ixxamen n l’aṣnam n Miṣra, ad sscemḍeɣ ixammen nni u ad awyeɣ l’aṣnam d imeḥbas. Netta ad yarḍ tammurt n Miṣra am umeksaw yarḍ arruḍ nnes uca netta ad zzayes dd-iffeɣ di řehna.
Netta ad yarẓ imayḍuten nsen iqeddsen, nni iǧan di temmurt n Miṣra, uca ad issecmeḍ ixxamen n l’aṣnam n Miṣra s tmessi.’”
